Container.Name: p5assets
Container.Overview: Compares your Plex libraries (and optionally Sonarr/Radarr) with your Kometa assets folders and shows missing posters and season posters (poster, Season00, Season01 …). Supports several worlds (e.g. HD and 4K), each with its own assets folder. Drag & drop single images, whole folders or ZIPs, and p5assets names the files the way Kometa expects. Also includes guided setup, online search (TMDb, TVDB, fanart.tv), a trash with undo, a check for weak posters, notifications via Discord, Telegram or ntfy, and an optional login.
Container.Requires: Plex Media Server and Kometa. Each assets folder must be the folder Kometa uses as asset_directory and must be writable. Change only the host port, never the container port 8080.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface (default 8484). The container port stays 8080.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings (Plex token, API keys), thumbnails (up to 600 MB) and trash (up to 2 GB)

Config.Name: Assets 1 (e.g. HD)
Config.Description: Kometa asset_directory for the first world (e.g. HD). Must be the same folder Kometa uses.

Config.Name: Assets 2 (e.g. 4K, optional)
Config.Description: Optional: Kometa asset_directory for a second world (e.g. 4K). Leave empty if you only need one world.

Config.Name: Assets 3 (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: Kometa asset_directory for a third world.
